pages.page_content:
# Overview

The notes service stores notes and answers search queries.

# Architecture & Data Flow

`api.py` authenticates, then delegates to the store.

# Note Storage

`NoteStore` wraps a SQLite connection.

# Search Ranking

`rank_notes` scores by term overlap.

# Bearer Tokens

`issue_token` and `verify_token` sign and check subjects.

naming.note: the timestamp is local wall clock, so the artifact name is not reproducible; the port should make it deterministic (wiki_version_id) and the fixture pins the body, not the name

notes: Sections with no matching generated page are dropped entirely.
Pages are matched to the structure by the page_id '{section}#{page}'; a title match is the fallback.
page_content is embedded in full — the structure JSON duplicates every page's markdown.
